column3: NKJV names “Jesus,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “answering, He said.”
Close to the Greek; “debtors” is rendered “sinners.”
NKJV supplies “well” to complete the conditional sentence and has “after that,” where the Greek has “in the time to come.”
NKJV has the singular “Hypocrite!,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has the plural.
NKJV includes “large,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “became a tree.”
NKJV has “gate,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “door.”
NKJV repeats “Lord, Lord,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “Lord” once.
